sloka: असंख्येयैः तु बाण ओघैः प्रममाथ प्रमाथिनम् ।स्थूलाक्षस्य अक्षिणी स्थूले पूरयामास सायकैः ॥३-२६-२१॥
transliteration: asaṁkhyeyaiḥ tu bāṇa oghaiḥ pramamātha pramāthinam ।sthūlākṣasya akṣiṇī sthūle pūrayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ ॥3-26-21॥

translations.english: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.
